name: @open-adms/field
description: Open ADMS field app (React + Vite + Capacitor, ARCHITECTURE §7–§12).

scripts.e2e: tsc --build && vite build && ADMS_FIELD_API_ORIGIN=https://stories.adms.localhost vite build --outDir dist/world && playwright install --only-shell chromium && (playwright test; screens=$?; playwright test --config playwright.mission.config.ts; mission=$?; [ $screens -eq 0 ] && [ $mission -eq 0 ])
scripts.try: tsc --build && ADMS_FIELD_API_ORIGIN=https://stories.adms.localhost vite build --outDir dist/world && node e2e/try.ts
